name: PrintStash
description: A self-hosted library for 3D models and the G-code that prints them
longDescription:
PrintStash keeps your 3D models, sliced G-code revisions and print history in one searchable library on your own server.

Preview STL, 3MF, OBJ, STEP and G-code in the browser, keep the revisions that printed well, index an existing folder in place, and send prints to Klipper/Moonraker, with beta support for OctoPrint, PrusaLink, Bambu Lab (LAN) and Elegoo printers.

More at printstash.org.
